nodes.description: Owned.owner : address of the current contract owner, set from msg.sender and transferable.
Owned.newOwner : pending owner address set by transferOwnership and cleared by acceptOwnership.
BitcoinFast.symbol : public token symbol string (BTCF).
BitcoinFast.name : public token name string.
BitcoinFast.decimals : token decimals (18).
BitcoinFast._totalSupply : total token supply, fixed in constructor.
BitcoinFast.balances : mapping of account address to token balance.
BitcoinFast.allowed : nested mapping owner=>spender=>allowance.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) : returns a+b with require(c>=a) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) : returns a-b with require(b<=a) underflow guard.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) : returns a*b with division-based overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) : returns a/b with require(b>0).
Owned() constructor : sets owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner : stages a new owner.
Owned.acceptOwnership() : requires msg.sender == newOwner, moves owner and zeroes newOwner.
BitcoinFast() constructor : initializes metadata, supply and pre-mints to a fixed address.
BitcoinFast.totalSupply() constant : returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
BitcoinFast.balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant : returns balances[tokenOwner].
BitcoinFast.transfer(address to, uint tokens) : moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to'.
BitcoinFast.approve(address spender, uint tokens) : writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no zero-check.
BitcoinFast.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) : spends allowance of msg.sender.
BitcoinFast.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant : returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
BitcoinFast.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) : approves then calls spender.receiveApproval.
BitcoinFast function() payable : unconditionally reverts incoming ETH.
BitcoinFast.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner : arbitrary external token transfer.
msg.sender read inside the Owned constructor to initialize owner.
msg.sender compared against owner in the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender compared against newOwner in acceptOwnership.
msg.sender used as the debit account in transfer.
msg.sender used as the allowance owner key in approve.
msg.sender used as the spender key in transferFrom.
msg.sender used both as allowance key and as the 'from' argument of the external call.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) made before state settles.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a caller-controlled contract address.
Arithmetic balance updates inside transfer (safeSub on sender, safeAdd on recipient).
Arithmetic balance and allowance updates inside transferFrom.
Addition c = a + b inside safeAdd guarded by require(c >= a).
Subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub guarded by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul guarded by division check.
Division c = a / b inside safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).
Subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply with no SafeMath guard.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender into the owner state variable.
Owned constructor execution depends on the msg.sender value.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner require(msg.sender == owner).
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by onlyOwner require(msg.sender == owner).
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
acceptOwnership rewrites owner from the caller-controlled newOwner flow.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
transferOwnership writes the _newOwner argument into newOwner.
BitcoinFast constructor sets symbol.
BitcoinFast constructor sets name.
BitcoinFast constructor sets decimals.
BitcoinFast constructor sets _totalSupply.
BitcoinFast constructor pre-mints the whole supply into balances of a fixed address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] for the burn adjustment.
totalSupply performs an unguarded subtraction of balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer treats msg.sender as the token owner account.
transfer writes both the sender and recipient balance entries.
transfer calls safeSub on balances[msg.sender].
transfer calls safeAdd on balances[to].
transfer balance updates rely on safeSub/safeAdd arithmetic.
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping that is debited and credited.
msg.sender determines which balance is subject to subtraction.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
allowed mapping is keyed by msg.sender in approve.
transferFrom treats msg.sender as the spender.
transferFrom updates the from and to balance entries.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] without any explicit allowance check before the arithmetic.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls safeAdd on balances[to].
transferFrom performs multiple chained arithmetic updates.
allowed[from][msg.sender] is read and decremented using caller identity.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
allowed mapping keyed by msg.sender inside approveAndCall.
approveAndCall performs an external call to a caller-supplied contract before returning.
msg.sender is forwarded as the 'from' argument to the external receiveApproval call.
The external receiveApproval implementation can re-enter approveAndCall or other token functions.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on the tokenAddress supplied by the owner.
The external ERC20 transfer can call back into this contract while state is still mutable.
safeAdd evaluates c = a + b before the require guard.
safeSub evaluates c = a - b before the require guard.
safeMul evaluates c = a * b before the require guard.
safeDiv evaluates c = a / b after the require(b > 0) guard.
Parameter _newOwner flows into newOwner inside transferOwnership.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes balances in balanceOf.
Parameter to becomes the credited account in transfer.
Parameter tokens is the transferred amount in transfer.
Parameter spender keys the allowed mapping in approve.
Parameter tokens is the approved amount in approve.
Parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the spent amount in transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender is both allowance target and external callee in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is the approved amount in approveAndCall.
Parameter data is forwarded raw to the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter tokenAddress is the caller-supplied external contract target in transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter tokens is the amount forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.

Parameter b only exists as the second operand of the safeAdd helper.
Local c is the transient return value of safeAdd.
Parameter a only exists as the first operand of the safeSub helper.
Parameter b only exists as the second operand of the safeSub helper.
Local c is the transient return value of safeSub.
Parameter a only exists as the first operand of the safeMul helper.
Parameter b only exists as the second operand of the safeMul helper.

Parameter a only exists as the first operand of the safeDiv helper.
Parameter b only exists as the divisor guard of the safeDiv helper.
Local c is the transient return value of safeDiv.
_newOwner is stored directly into the newOwner state through transferOwnership.
tokenOwner is only a lookup key for balances in balanceOf.
The to argument is only the credit key used by transfer.
The tokens argument is only the transferred amount used by transfer.
spender is only an allowance key written by approve.
tokens is only the approved amount written by approve.
from is only the debit key consumed by transferFrom.
to is only the credit key consumed by transferFrom.
tokens is only the moved amount consumed by transferFrom.
tokenOwner is only a lookup key in allowance.
spender is only a lookup key in allowance.
spender is both the allowance key and the external callee, so it is subsumed by the unsafe external call.
tokens is only the approved/forwarded amount in approveAndCall.
Unvalidated data is only forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress only exists as the target of the unsafe external ERC20 call.
tokens is only the amount forwarded in transferAnyERC20Token.
